title: QiMeng-ChipV-RTL: Exploiting Information Locality for IP-level Verilog Generation
abstract: arXiv:2602.00704v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The generation of Register-Transfer Level (RTL) code is a crucial yet labor-intensive step in digital hardware design, traditionally requiring engineers to manually translate complex specifications into thousands of lines of synthesizable Hardware Description Language (HDL) code. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise in automating this process, existing approaches--including fine-tuned domain-specific models and advanced agent-based systems--struggle to scale to industrial IP-level design tasks. We identify three key challenges: (1) handling long, highly detailed documents, where critical interface constraints become buried in unrelated submodule descriptions; (2) generating long RTL code, where both syntactic and semantic correctness degrade sharply with increasing output length; and (3) navigating the complex debugging cycles required for functional verification through simulation and waveform analysis. translated_title: 启明芯片RTL：利用信息局部性进行IP级Verilog生成
translated_abstract: 寄存器传输级（RTL）代码的生成是数字硬件设计中一个关键且劳动密集的步骤，传统上需要工程师手动将复杂规范翻译成数千行可综合的硬件描述语言（HDL）代码。尽管大型语言模型（LLMs）在自动化此过程中展现出潜力，但现有方法——包括微调的领域特定模型和先进的基于代理的系统——在扩展到工业级IP设计任务时面临困难。我们识别出三个关键挑战：（1）处理冗长且高度详细的文档，其中关键的接口约束被无关的子模块描述所掩盖；（2）生成较长的RTL代码，随着输出长度的增加，语法和语义正确性急剧下降；（3）应对通过仿真和波形分析进行功能验证所需的复杂调试循环。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了一种利用信息局部性的方法，旨在提高IP级Verilog生成的效率和准确性。
tldr: 本文提出了一种利用信息局部性的方法，以应对工业级IP设计中的长文档处理、长代码生成和复杂调试等挑战，从而提升IP级Verilog生成的效率和准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a method exploiting information locality to address challenges in industrial IP-level design, including long document handling, long code generation, and complex debugging, thereby improving the efficiency and accuracy of IP-level Verilog generation.
